bugs.title: OTP SMS delivery fails on Zong network numbers
bugs.description: Appointment booking OTP messages are not delivered to Zong subscribers (prefix 031x). Twilio gateway shows "delivered" but users never receive the SMS.
bugs.stepsToReproduce:
1. Enter a Zong mobile number (031x) during booking OTP step
2. Click "Send OTP"
3. Wait 60 seconds — no message received
4. Retry — still no delivery
bugs.expectedResult: OTP arrives within 30 seconds on all Pakistani networks (Jazz, Zong, Ufone, Telenor).
bugs.actualResult: OTP delivered on Jazz and Telenor, silently dropped on Zong and Ufone numbers.
bugs.resolutionNotes: Investigating DLT registration status with Twilio Pakistan local sender ID.

bugs.title: JWT token expiry causes silent dashboard freeze
bugs.description: When the session token expires after 7 days, background API calls fail silently without redirecting the user to the login screen.
bugs.stepsToReproduce:
1. Set token to an expired value in localStorage
2. Refresh the page
3. Observe dashboard loading spinner
bugs.expectedResult: Axios interceptor catches 401, clears session, and redirects to /login.
bugs.actualResult: Dashboard shows a permanent loading skeleton with no error.
bugs.resolutionNotes: Resolved: Attached global Axios response interceptor in api.js to detect 401 and redirect to /login?session=expired.

bugs.title: JazzCash escrow double-debit on network timeout
bugs.description: When JazzCash API times out during payment confirmation, retried webhook hits the server before the transaction lock releases — resulting in two debit entries for the same job.
bugs.stepsToReproduce:
1. Initiate a worker payout via JazzCash
2. Simulate a 12-second API timeout
3. JazzCash retries webhook after 5 seconds
4. Inspect ledger — two debit records for same transaction
bugs.expectedResult: Idempotency key rejects the duplicate webhook and returns 200 without re-processing.
bugs.actualResult: Two separate ledger entries with identical reference numbers.

bugs.title: Worker profile photo upload fails on slow 3G connections
bugs.description: CNIC verification photo upload times out after 30 seconds on 3G connections. No retry mechanism — worker loses form progress and must restart the entire verification flow.
bugs.stepsToReproduce:
1. Throttle network to 3G (750kbps) in DevTools
2. Upload a 2MB CNIC photo
3. Wait for request — timeout at 30s
4. Form resets to step 1
bugs.expectedResult: Chunked upload with progress indicator and resumable upload on reconnect.
bugs.actualResult: Hard timeout, full form reset, no progress saved.
bugs.resolutionNotes: Resolved: Implemented chunked file upload with tus.io protocol. Progress state stored in sessionStorage to survive page refreshes.

bugs.title: KisanLink crop price chart renders blank on mobile Safari
bugs.description: The commodity price trend chart (Recharts BarChart) renders as a blank white box on iOS Safari 17. Data loads correctly but SVG paths are not painted.
bugs.stepsToReproduce:
1. Open KisanLink on iPhone (iOS 17, Safari)
2. Navigate to commodity price page
3. Chart container appears but SVG is empty
bugs.expectedResult: Bar chart renders correctly with price data on all browsers including iOS Safari.
bugs.actualResult: Blank white box where the chart should render.
